description: Source code for a tool that creates firmware images for the Linksys WRT350N v2 router, including parsing parameter files, constructing binary images, zipping, and embedding MD5 checksums.

methods.name: parse_par_file
methods.description: Parses the parameter file to extract firmware layout and file information.

methods.name: create_bin_file
methods.description: Creates a binary firmware image by combining specified files and adding special data.

methods.name: create_zip_file
methods.description: Creates a zip archive containing the firmware binary.

methods.name: create_img_file
methods.description: Creates a final firmware image file with embedded MD5 checksum and embedded zip.

methods.name: lprintf
methods.description: Logging function that outputs messages based on verbosity level.
